_howto: Фото класти в assets/work/armour/. Імена файлів нижче — саме їх чекає сторінка. Найпростіше: python3 tools/add_media.py armour <файл> --set ragbound --piece worn

sets.name: Ragbound
sets.text: Sackcloth wound over a dark under-layer, hide straps and rusted salvage. The bandana covers head and face as one piece, so the set needed no rebuild when the mask slot was folded into the helm.

sets.name: Tattercoat
sets.text: Faded crimson over dust blue, splinted wood and dull iron. The other half of the starting tier — same budget, opposite palette, so two players in Common gear never read as the same character.

sets.name: Forgeborn
sets.text: Dark iron and deep gold: a faceted sallet with a swept tail, a crest, and the full faceplate. This is the reference set — every later set is measured against its proportions.

sets.name: Bonewrought
sets.text: Bone, horn and hide on near-black, with green light in the eye sockets. A horned crown over a skull face: brow, sockets, nasal and nine teeth. The two shoulders are different pieces — a beast skull on the right, scutes on the left.

sets.name: Hoarfrost
sets.text: Frozen steel, clear ice and rime. Icicle growth breaks the silhouette at the shoulders and shins without adding weight to the mesh.

sets.name: Abyssclad
sets.text: Drowned bronze and verdigris. The helm is one sealed bell with three glazed ports for a face — a solid of revolution from the chin line to above the crown, so it claims its volume from every angle, not just from the front. Coral and barnacles grow from a per-piece seed.

sets.name: Riftsworn
sets.text: Near-black violet plate broken into fragments held a finger apart, with rift light standing in every gap. No plate is whole: the gap is a real second shell in glow material behind the break, not a painted line. Some fragments touch nothing at all.

sets.name: Dawnbreak
sets.text: White plate, a thread of gold, and more light than metal: six wings of neon behind the shoulders, two rings behind the head touching nothing, and a lens of light where another set would set a stone. The helm is an open frame — the face volume is filled by a band of neon rather than a plate.
